description: This file declares the 'Clearcut' class responsible for sending various metrics events related to VM and device state in the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes method declarations for sending specific events like VM start/stop, device boot, and lock screen, utilizing an internal static method 'SendEvent'. It also includes necessary headers for related protobuf metrics.

classes.name: Clearcut
classes.description: A class providing static methods to send various device and VM event metrics, encapsulating the logic for logging these events.
